source_geometry.source_layer_basis: Twenty visibly handwritten slots occur between typed indices 74 and 75. Under the primary D reading, they duplicate the next four typed groups. The 238 typed slots independently match the printed length.

alternative_composite_transmission_model.model: Treat all 258 slots, including the handwriting, as transmitted material before excluding the annotation positions.
alternative_composite_transmission_model.status: Separate conditional interpretation; not a zero-cost transmission deletion.

review.reason: The handwritten third rounded glyph of DDDDF can be read as D or O. The following typed DDDDF supports a duplicate-annotation interpretation but does not independently resolve this glyph.

limits: Typed and handwritten source layers are preserved separately. The accepted typed-only frame does not depend on the D/O annotation ambiguity; the composite-transmission interpretation carries an explicit 20-slot exclusion cost.
